script_beats.gist: hook. Let's play a guessing game. I'm thinking of a number from one to one hundred.
the slow way. You could guess one, two, three, four. That could take a hundred tries.
the trick. Guess the middle, fifty. Too high? Throw away all the bigger numbers.
again. Guess the middle of what is left. Twenty five. Too low? Throw away the smaller ones.
payoff. Every guess cuts the pile in half. Seven guesses. That is binary search.

assets.shows:
ElevenLabs neural narration (George, eleven_multilingual_v2) of the five lines of NOTEBOOK.md in order as one take, 150 ms lead-in, 1 s of silence at the end. Says: Let's play a guessing game. I'm thinking of a number from one to one hundred.
You could guess one, two, three, four. That could take a hundred tries.
Here is the trick. Guess the middle, fifty. Too high? Then throw away all the bigger numbers.
Guess the middle of what is left. Twenty five. Too low? Throw away the smaller ones.
Every guess cuts the pile in half. Seven guesses and you have found it. That is binary search.
